text: そういえば　となりの　オーキドはかせが　あなたを　よんでたわよ

structure.jp: となりの　オーキドはかせが
あなたを　よんでたわよ

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた after a verb says the action was going on in the past. Here it is shortened to てた, as people do when talking. よんでた = 'was calling'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end gives a soft, womanly tone, and よ adds 'I'm telling you'. よんでたわよ = 'he was calling you, you know'.
